ACT XX OF 2018
ACT XX OF 2018
SINDH MINIMUM WAGES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2018
An Act to amend the Sindh Minimum Wages Act, 2015
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 17th May, 2018]
No.PAS/LEGIS-B-17/2018,
dated 17.5.2018.---The Sindh
Minimum Wages (Amendment) Bill, 2018 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Sindh on 20th April, 2018 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 12th May, 2018 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Sindh
Minimum Wages Act, 2015, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Sindh Minimum Wages (Amendment) Act, 2018.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 3 of Sindh Act No. VIII of 2016

It

2. Amendment
of section 3 of Sindh Act No. VIII of 2016.---In the Sindh Minimum Wages Act, 2015, in section 3, in subsection (1)-
(i) in
clauses (b) and (c), for the word "one", the word "four"
shall be substituted;
(ii) after
clause (e), the following shall be substituted:-
"(f)
one independent member (coopted)".
